name: update-range
description: Updates cells in a Google Sheets tab: writes rows of values into an A1 range, replacing what is there, as if typed (formulas and numbers are parsed). The spreadsheet can be a URL copied from the browser or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets; tab names come from google-sheets__list-tabs, and row numbers from google-sheets__find-rows.

spreadsheet.description: The spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or the spreadsheet id taken from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.

range.description: The cells to replace in A1 notation without the tab name, such as B2:C3 or B5. A row number can come from google-sheets__find-rows.
